title: BMP280
text: Measure barometric air pressure and ambient temperature from BMP280 sensor, 3 outputs, {Data type} sets Output data type for values from BMP280 sensor; {I2C Module} sets the specific module used for I2C communication, {I2C address}, {Pressure (Pa)} sets the output port for reading pressure, {Temperature (℃)} sets the output port for reading temperature, {Status} sets the output port for obtaining status of selected, {Sample time} sets the time interval to read data, {Filter coeffiecient} sets the filter coefficient value, {Pressure sensitivity factor (Pa)} and {Temperature sensitivity factor (℃)}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Status of values read for pressure and temperature 0 | 1

params.name: I2C Module
params.values: Specific module used for I2C communication I2C_A (default)

params.name: I2C address
params.values: I2C address to communicate with the BMP280 sensor 0x76 (default) | 0x77

params.name: Pressure (Pa)
params.values: Set output port for reading pressure on (default) | off

params.name: Temperature (℃)
params.values: Set output port for reading temperature on (default) | off

params.name: Status
params.values: Set output port for obtaining status of selected outputs on (default) | off

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type for values from BMP280 sensor single (default) | double | uint32

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Time interval to read data -1 (default) | positive integer
